description: This file defines the ILogViewAdaptorHost interface used by grains implementing log-view consistency in Orleans. It provides methods for updating views and handling state changes, and extends IConnectionIssueListener.

classes.name: ILogViewAdaptorHost
classes.description: Interface for grains using log-view consistency, providing callbacks for view updates and state changes.

methods.name: UpdateView
methods.description: Updates the log view with a new view and log entry.

methods.name: OnViewChanged
methods.description: Notifies the host about changes in the view's tentative and confirmed states.
